desc: Sort intervals by (right, left, index); build arrays L, R, W, origIdx; compute p[i] = count of intervals with R < L[i] via bisect_left.
Implement iterative DP dp[i][k] = (best weight, best sorted index tuple) over first i sorted intervals choosing exactly k; transitions skip vs take with insort merge; compare via weight then tuple.
Select final answer as best among dp[n][0..4]; return as list.
Verify against both examples and edge cases: all mutually overlapping, n < 4, equal weights differing index sets, boundary-touching (r == l counts as overlapping).
